description: Every configuration key Hivorr reads, its classification, and the environments in which a missing value must stop startup or deployment. Values never live here. EP-01-043.

sources.config: Read by the API and worker through server/src/config.ts.
sources.tooling: Read by deployment and topology preflight scripts.
sources.deployment: Read by the deployment workflow or the provider, never by the application.

keys.name: HIVORR_ENV
keys.description: Deployment environment. Selects defaults and audience resolution.

keys.name: BACKEND_ENVIRONMENT
keys.description: Backend environment. Must match HIVORR_ENV when set.

keys.name: SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
keys.description: Project reference the database URL must belong to.

keys.name: API_PORT
keys.description: HTTP listen port. Defaults to 3000.

keys.name: API_HOST
keys.description: HTTP listen host. Defaults to 0.0.0.0.

keys.name: LOG_LEVEL
keys.description: Structured logger threshold. Defaults to info.

keys.name: SESSION_ISSUER
keys.description: Label recorded on issued sessions. Sessions are opaque, not signed.

keys.name: MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY
keys.description: 32-byte base64 key that encrypts TOTP secrets. Per environment.

keys.name: RELEASE_SHA
keys.description: Commit SHA of the running artifact. Injected by the deployment.

keys.name: RELEASE_DIGEST
keys.description: Release manifest digest of the running artifact, when recorded.

keys.name: DATABASE_URL
keys.description: Runtime database connection string.

keys.name: DATABASE_SSL_CA
keys.description: PEM root certificate for the database host. Public, not a credential.

keys.name: EDGE_SHARED_SECRET
keys.description: Shared secret the edge proxy presents with a forwarded host.

keys.name: WORKER_DATABASE_URL
keys.description: Least-privilege worker connection string. Falls back to DATABASE_URL.

keys.name: WORKER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS
keys.description: Outbox poll interval. Defaults to 1000.

keys.name: WORKER_BATCH_SIZE
keys.description: Outbox batch size. Defaults to 20.

keys.name: WORKER_LEASE_MS
keys.description: Outbox lease duration. Defaults to 60000.

keys.name: WORKER_MAX_ATTEMPTS
keys.description: Delivery attempts before dead-lettering. Defaults to 5.

keys.name: WORKER_RETRY_BASE_MS
keys.description: Exponential retry base. Defaults to 5000.

keys.name: WORKER_HEALTH_PORT
keys.description: Worker health listen port. Defaults to 3001.

keys.name: WORKER_HEALTH_HOST
keys.description: Worker health listen host. Defaults to 0.0.0.0.

keys.name: WORKER_ID
keys.description: Worker identity. Derived from environment, host and pid when unset.

keys.name: CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
keys.description: Comma-separated exact origin allowlist. Empty means same-origin only.

keys.name: ZEPTOMAIL_TOKEN
keys.description: ZeptoMail send-mail token. Unset keeps email delivery off and the capture adapter active.

keys.name: ZEPTOMAIL_API_URL
keys.description: ZeptoMail send endpoint for the account region. Defaults to the US endpoint.

keys.name: MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS
keys.description: Verified sender address for transactional email, for example no-reply@mail.hivorr.com.

keys.name: MAIL_FROM_NAME
keys.description: Display name on transactional email. Defaults to Hivorr.

keys.name: PUBLIC_APP_ORIGIN
keys.description: Public origin of the main portal, used to build invitation links in email.

keys.name: AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS
keys.description: Authentication rate-limit window. Defaults to 60000.

keys.name: AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_IDENTIFIER_MAX
keys.description: Authentication attempts per identifier per window. Defaults to 10.

keys.name: AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_IP_MAX
keys.description: Authentication attempts per IP per window. Defaults to 30.

keys.name: AUTH_LOCKOUT_ATTEMPTS
keys.description: Failed sign-ins before credential lockout. Defaults to 5.

keys.name: AUTH_LOCKOUT_MS
keys.description: Credential lockout duration. Defaults to 15 minutes.

keys.name: TRUST_PROXY
keys.description: Whether the HTTP adapter trusts proxy forwarding headers. Defaults to false.

keys.name: EXPECTED_SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
keys.description: Deployment preflight target. Must match the deployment's reference.

keys.name: STAGING_SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
keys.description: Staging reference used by the topology preflight when the manifest omits it.

keys.name: PRODUCTION_SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
keys.description: Production reference used by the topology preflight when the manifest omits it.

keys.name: FLY_API_TOKEN
keys.description: Fly.io deploy token. Deployment only; never read by the API or worker.

keys.name: MIGRATOR_DATABASE_URL
keys.description: CI-only migration connection string. Never injected into Fly or the runtime.
